item.title: Gunsmoke - The Goldtakers
item.description: A gang of thieves commandeers the Dodge City blacksmith shop to divide a gigantic bar of gold.

item.title: The Waltons - The Ghost Story
item.description: Strange things are occurring at the Walton home. The family uses a Ouija board to ask questions about the happenings

item.title: Hawaii Five-O - Three Dead Cows at Makapuu (Part 1)
item.description: A biological scientist views his work as evil.

item.title: Matlock - The Chef
item.description: When a wife is accused of poisoning her ex-husband during the taping of a television cooking show, Matlock is hired to uncover the truth in this seemingly open-and-shut case.

item.title: Perry Mason - The Case of the Lonely Eloper
item.description: Merle Telford is a naive and maladjusted young woman who is about to turn 21 and receive a substantial inheritance. She plans to run away from her guardians and elope with Danny Pierce as soon as she receives her money.

item.title: Leave It to Beaver - The Poor Loser
item.description: Ward is given two tickets to a baseball game and is faced with an impossible decision. Should he take Wally or Beaver? Beaver lets him off the hook when he announces he has plans with Gilbert. However, when they fall through, Beaver changes his mind about the game and becomes convinced because he's the youngest he gets the short stick.

item.title: Leave It to Beaver - The Book Report
item.description: Beaver has been assigned to write a book report on 'The Three Musketeers.' However he's waited right down to the wire to get reading and quickly realizes that he'll never get finished. So, he decides to watch the movie that's going to be on TV and write his book report based on the movie.

item.title: Toon In With Me - Porky's Debut
item.description: Toon In With Me - Porky's Debut

item.title: Adam-12 - The Dinosaur
item.description: Eight years after an act of heroism put him out of commission, an officer returns to active duty, only to find that the changes made to the job that limit an officer's power and increase suspects' rights are too much to handle.

item.title: Adam-12 - Assassination
item.description: Malloy and Reed become the repeated targets of an unidentified sniper who has them called to fake disturbances and follows them to some of their real calls, which include a special deliver, a suicide threat at a gas station and a reported prowler.
